The coverage map connects every requirement to planned work. Labels are provisional until setup creates ticket IDs.

| Requirement and source | Tickets | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Add a visitor’s first name and repair item — `BRIEF.md` | Q1, Q3 | Valid entries appear in the queue; invalid input shows clear errors |
| Repairers take the next visitor — `BRIEF.md` | Q2, Q3 | FIFO selection; simultaneous requests never claim the same visitor |
| Mark a repair finished — `BRIEF.md` | Q2, Q3 | Finished visitors disappear from active lists; repeated completion is harmless |
| Show waiting and helped visitors — `BRIEF.md` | V1 | Public board reflects both states and handles an empty queue |
| Refresh every ten seconds — your answer | V1 | Timer tests verify polling, no overlapping requests, and recovery after outages |
| One volunteer and 3–6 repairers — your answer | Q2, Q3, C2 | Concurrent-client tests and a complete workflow demonstration |
| First names only — your answer | Q1, Q3, V1 | No surname/contact fields; public display excludes repair details |
| Nothing retained after day’s end — your answer | C1, Q1, Q3, V1, C2 | Storage policy resolved before implementation; expiry tests cover server data, all screens and offline views |
| Keep existing frontend and backend — your answer | B1, B2 | Preserve Vite/JavaScript and FastAPI/Python; establish their verification commands |
| SMS alerts — `BRIEF.md`, later scope | Explicitly deferred | No SMS implementation in version one |

The day-end requirement remains binding. **C1 must resolve storage before Q1 starts:** durable storage cannot delete records while its host is powered off. Approval of setup does not approve relaxing your retention requirement.

Supporting work covers test tooling and full-app startup in B2, interaction/privacy review in C1, and first-version acceptance in C2. Duplicate-name references, trusted-network access without sign-in, and FIFO ordering are labelled assumptions chosen under your delegation.

This inspection changes no scope, dependencies or responsibilities. The package remains **eight tickets**, with the review’s counting correction incorporated.
